---
title: "Case study: a wording effect that leaves the person ordering alone"
---

The Height Inventory asks about self-perceived height with thirteen items worded in each direction by design. Its wording-unit difference survives every single-item removal, and yet the equal-unit and wording-unit person measures agree to four decimals against a criterion collected outside the inventory -- a unit difference can be decisive for the items and inconsequential for the persons, and only a criterion says which.

The complete script ships with the package and runs from a plain R session:

```r
file.edit(system.file("casestudies", "wording_units_height.R", package = "rasch"))
```

```{r script, echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE, code = readLines(file.path("..", "..", "inst", "casestudies", "wording_units_height.R"))}
```
